responsibility: Provides the generated documentation URL mapping for FR-V target options declared in frv.opt. This file belongs to GCC’s option-description metadata rather than code generation itself: for each supported -m option it records the manual anchor suffix in the FRV options chapter, allowing the option-processing and diagnostics/documentation infrastructure to associate parsed FR-V command-line switches with the correct online help or warning documentation entry; options without a resolved manual anchor are explicitly omitted.
